tagline: Leading specialty and title insurance underwriter serving commercial lines and institutional clients
hero_kpi_rationale: Specialty insurance revenue represents 65% of total revenue and shows robust year-over-year growth of 10.8%, reflecting the strength of commercial diversification and performance in liability and property lines.

kpis.name: Specialty Insurance Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by specialty insurance business segment including commercial auto, workers compensation, property and other commercial lines
kpis.description: Revenue generated by the Specialty Insurance segment covering commercial lines including commercial auto, workers' compensation, property, general liability, financial indemnity, and home and auto warranty

kpis.name: Title Insurance Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by title insurance business segment including title insurance premiums and fees
kpis.description: Revenue generated by the Title Insurance segment, including net premiums and fees earned from title insurance operations

kpis.name: Combined Ratio
kpis.explanation: Ratio combining loss ratio and expense ratio, measuring underwriting profitability where ratios below 100% indicate underwriting profits
kpis.description: Consolidated combined ratio across all coverages reflecting the sum of loss ratio (41.9%) and expense ratio (52.8%), indicating strong underwriting discipline and profitability
kpis.signal: Stable underwriting performance with healthy profitability margins

kpis.name: Specialty Insurance Combined Ratio
kpis.explanation: Combined ratio for specialty insurance segment reflecting loss ratio of 63.9% and expense ratio of 29.3%
kpis.description: Specialty Insurance segment combined ratio showing healthy underwriting margins with loss ratio of 63.9% and expense ratio of 29.3%, generating solid profitability
kpis.signal: Strong underwriting profitability in specialty insurance

kpis.name: Title Insurance Combined Ratio
kpis.explanation: Combined ratio for title insurance segment reflecting loss ratio of 2.2% and expense ratio of 95.4%
kpis.description: Title Insurance segment combined ratio with very low loss ratio of 2.2% reflecting favorable claims experience and stable operations
kpis.signal: Stable title insurance underwriting with minimal loss experience

kpis.name: Specialty Insurance Pretax Income
kpis.explanation: Pretax income generated by specialty insurance operations
kpis.description: Pretax income from Specialty Insurance segment reflecting underwriting and investment income
